description: Parent app: create the entire (parent) route group from scratch with 5 glassmorphism screens (Dashboard, Attendance, Fees, Records, Remarks). Ported from the web parent pages. Depends on FEAT-001 (GlassCard, GLASS constants, parent MockUser, ps-003 seed entry, parent routing in index.tsx + _layout.tsx). FEAT-002 is independent — FEAT-003 can be implemented in any order relative to FEAT-002, but FEAT-001 must be done first.
steps: STEP 1 — Create app/src/app/(parent)/_layout.tsx: Tabs navigator with 5 screens. Glass tab bar same as teacher. Screens: dashboard (icon 'home-outline', title 'Home'), attendance (icon 'checkbox-outline', title 'Attendance'), fees (icon 'cash-outline', title 'Fees'), records (icon 'document-text-outline', title 'Records'), remarks (icon 'chatbubble-outline', title 'Remarks'). Import GLASS from '@/lib/utils'.

STEP 2 — Create helper pattern used by all parent screens: All 5 screens resolve the parent profile and children using this pattern: (1) const { user } = useAuth(); (2) const parents = await mockDb.query<Parent>('parents', { user_id: user?.id }); const parent = parents[0] ?? null; (3) const links = await mockDb.query<ParentStudent>('parent_students', { parent_id: parent?.id }); (4) const allStudents = await mockDb.getAll<Student>('students'); const children = allStudents.filter(s => links.some(l => l.student_id === s.id)); (5) Resolve class/section names from classes+sections tables. This pattern must be used identically in all 5 screens. Note: seed data gives parent-001 two children: student-001 (Aakash Verma, Class 1 Sec A) and student-006 (Neha Verma, Class 5 Sec A).

STEP 3 — Create app/src/app/(parent)/dashboard.tsx: Port from src/pages/parent/ParentDashboard.tsx. Full glass background. Inline glass header titled 'Dashboard'. Child selector: if children.length > 1, render horizontal chip row (same chip style as teacher screens). Child info GlassCard: Avatar (getInitials), name, class-section. Stats row (4 GlassCards or one GlassCard with 4 columns): Attendance Rate (GLASS.success), Pending Fees count (GLASS.error), Academic Records count (GLASS.info), Remarks count (GLASS.warning). Two side-by-side GlassCards: Recent Result (subject, exam, marks/max, grade) and Recent Remark (remark text, category, date). Fee Summary GlassCard: list first 5 fees with fee_type, remaining amount, status badge. Load: attendance (query by student_id), fees (query by student_id), student_records (query by student_id), remarks (query by student_id). AttendanceRate = present count / total * 100. PendingFees = fees where status !== 'paid'.

STEP 4 — Create app/src/app/(parent)/attendance.tsx: Port from src/pages/parent/ParentAttendance.tsx. Glass background + inline header titled 'Attendance'. Child selector chip row. Load attendance records for selected child (query by student_id). Stats GlassCard: 4 stats: rate %, present, absent, late+leave. Records list in GlassCard: each row — date (formatDate), status badge (colored dot: GLASS.present/absent/late), notes or '—'. Empty state with 'No attendance records'. Pull-to-refresh.

STEP 5 — Create app/src/app/(parent)/fees.tsx: Port from src/pages/parent/ParentFees.tsx. Glass background + inline header titled 'Fees'. Child selector chip row. Load fees for selected child (query by student_id). 3-column stat GlassCard: Total Fees (formatCurrency), Paid (GLASS.success text), Outstanding (GLASS.error text). Fee list GlassCard: rows with fee_type, amount, paid_amount, remaining_amount, due_date, status badge. Status badge: 'paid' → GLASS.paid, 'pending' → GLASS.pending, 'overdue' → GLASS.overdue. seed data: fee-001 (student-001, paid ₹5000), fee-006 (student-006, paid ₹5000 via upi).

STEP 6 — Create app/src/app/(parent)/records.tsx: Port from src/pages/parent/ParentRecords.tsx. Glass background + inline header titled 'Records'. Child selector chip row. Load student_records for selected child (query by student_id). Records list in GlassCard: each row — subject_name, exam_name (capitalize), marks/max_marks, grade (colored pill: A+/A→GLASS.success, B+/B→GLASS.accent, C/D→GLASS.warning, F→GLASS.error), formatDate(date), teacher_comment or '—'. Empty state. seed data: sr-001 (student-001, Mathematics, Unit Test 1, 42/50, A).

STEP 7 — Create app/src/app/(parent)/remarks.tsx: Port from src/pages/parent/ParentRemarks.tsx. Glass background + inline header titled 'Remarks'. Child selector chip row. Load remarks for selected child (query by student_id). Each remark in GlassCard: category badge (GLASS.accentGlow bg, GLASS.accent text), remark text (GLASS.textMuted), date (GLASS.textDim), teacher name (resolve from teachers table by teacher_id — can be '—' if not found). Visibility label: 'public'→nothing shown, 'parents_only'→small badge 'Parents Only' in GLASS.warning, 'staff_only' not visible to parents (skip those). Empty state GlassCard with icon 'chatbubble-outline' and text 'No remarks from teachers yet'.

findings: All 6 files created from scratch replacing the placeholder screens. The _layout.tsx uses the same glass dark tab bar pattern as (teacher). All 5 screens use the identical parent data resolution pattern (query parents by user_id → parent_students by parent_id → filter students). Child selector chip row is shown only when children.length > 1. remarks.tsx filters out staff_only visibility remarks and shows a custom empty state GlassCard when none visible. stats in dashboard use 4 flex-equal GlassCards in a row. npx tsc --noEmit passes with 0 errors.
